tab.title: Change Requests
tab.emptyDescription: Either party can propose a change to scope, timeline, or cost once the contract is approved.

create.title: Propose a change request
create.scopePlaceholder: Summarize what's changing, e.g. "Add two additional website pages to the design"
create.selectMilestone: Select a milestone to propose changes for...
create.milestonesRequired: Add at least one affected milestone
create.resultingHintPercent: The new total contract value once this change is approved (not the difference) — percentages above are recalculated against this total.
create.resultingHintFixed: The new total contract value once this change is approved — automatically calculated as the sum of every milestone's amount, including the changes above.

detail.title: Change Request
detail.readOnly: This request is pending the other party's decision and is read-only until then.

validation.scopeMin: Describe the scope change in at least {min, number, plain} characters
validation.valuePositive: Resulting value must be greater than zero
validation.tooManyFiles: You can attach up to {max, number, plain} files
